The '''Mussel''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught using a [[Crab Pot]] in any [[Crab Pot#Saltwater|saltwater]] body of water. It can also be [[Foraging|foraged]] from [[the Beach]], mined from a [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Mussel Node]] on the [[Ginger Island]] [[Ginger Island#The Beach|beach]], gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]], or randomly found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|30}}. Like all fish caught from the crab pot, it cannot be eaten unless it is used in a [[Cooking]] recipe or [[Smoked Fish|smoked]].

75 Mussels can be traded for a [[Mango Sapling]] at the [[Island Trader]].

==Tailoring==
Mussel can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt261a.png|24px]]

==Fish Pond==
Mussels can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every day. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. Typical output includes dark gray Mussel [[Roe]], [[Seaweed]], and various [[Trash]] items, but more valuable items are possible starting at population 5.

==Quests==
* One Mussel may be requested by several ocean fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.
* Five Mussel may be requested by [[Giant Stump#Questline|The Raccoon]] as part of the first request or as part of the sixth request and beyond.
